summary: John's 2nd cousin 9x removed via Bull Smith (also 3C9R via Topping); Orange County militia colonel and NY state senator — very probably the 'Colonel Woodhull' under whom Thomas Lamoreaux served.
bio: Commanded the 1st Regiment of Orange County Militia (the Cornwall-area regiment); later NY state senator. SAR record for Thomas Lamoreaux says he served under 'Colonel Woodhull' (first name not given) — so Thomas very probably served under a cousin of his wife Keturah.
